reviews.comment: Took her for yoga and she was very laid back. She did not grade based on skill and really fosters a relaxing environment. Not time-consuming work, just show up to class. However, she is willing to work with students if something comes up.

I took pilates with her and absolutely loved it! Every class was exercising, no other stuff that took up time that we could be moving! She never wants you to overexert yourself and be in pain. I've gained lifelong skills and exercises to use too! She's my favorite KINE instructor so far and I wish I could take pilates with her again!

Great professor who really cares about her students and understand they have more demanding classes. Took for pilates and workouts were fun and not graded by ability, weekly health quizzes and individual assignments. Work in groups weekly to complete assignments. Great class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Caring
